statements.text: Set label: it is the menu's only accessible name. Despite the property's doc comment, there is no fallback to the trigger's text.
It sets aria-haspopup, aria-expanded and aria-controls on the trigger. violet-button forwards them to its inner button; violet-icon-button does not, so use violet-button or a native button.

attributes.description: Accessible label for the menu panel. Falls back to the trigger's text content when not set.
attributes.name: label

events.description: Emitted when the menu opens or closes. Detail: `{ open: boolean }`.
events.name: open-change

slots.description: Menu content: `<violet-menu-item>` elements and optional `<hr>` separators.
The button element that toggles the menu. Must be a focusable element.
slots.name: trigger

summary: Action menu: a slotted trigger opens a floating list of violet-menu-item actions. For choosing a value, use a select instead.

usage.text: Children: one focusable element in the trigger slot, then violet-menu-item elements with optional <hr> separators. Every violet-menu-item descendant counts as an item, so do not nest menus.
The trigger toggles it on click; ArrowDown or ArrowUp opens it on the first or last item. open is a property with no attribute: set it or call show(), hide() and toggle().
Listen for invoke on each item, or on the menu and read event.target. The menu then closes and returns focus to the trigger if focus was still inside it.
In the open menu arrows wrap, Home and End jump, typed letters move to a matching item, Enter or Space invokes, Escape closes and refocuses the trigger, and Tab closes it and moves on.
